messages:
Noah Rivera: LumenResell flagged invoice INV-2026-0618 - they were charged marketplace fees twice and want an adjustment. Total billed $2,750, duplicate marketplace fee = $250. They requested a goodwill refund + a credit for the processing delay.

Zara Khan: Can you confirm which line is duplicated? I pulled invoice: marketplace_fee $250 appears twice (line 3 & 7). Looks like our partner-sync job ran twice during the billing window.

Noah Rivera: Correct. Customer asks for two things: refund $250 for the duplicate charge, plus a $50 goodwill credit for the extra admin time. Suggest issuing refund $250 to card and a credit note CN-1860 for $50 applied to next invoice. Need approval for the goodwill.

Miguel Ortega: Approved. Refund $250 and create CN-1860 for $50. Use GL codes refund=7001, credit=6543. Mark root cause partner_sync_dup. Tag audit ID LUMEN_RES_0618.

Noah Rivera: Running commands:
```
/stripe-refund --txn ch_4Jt9_dup --amount 250 --reason "duplicate marketplace fee - partner sync" --metadata invoice=INV-2026-0618
/create-credit --customer acct_lumen_77 --amount 50 --reason "goodwill credit for admin delay" --acct_code 6543 --apply_next_invoice true
```

billing-bot: Refund created REF-5699 amount $250 linked to INV-2026-0618. Credit created CN-1860 amount $50 status=applied_to_next_invoice. Ledger notes appended. Posted to accounting queue.

Noah Rivera: Notified LumenResell and cc'd partner manager. Customer replied "appreciate the quick fix". Closing thread and filing ticket ENG-1935 to fix partner-sync dedupe.

Zara Khan: Added month=June_2026, audit_tag=LUMEN_RES_0618 to ledger entry. All set.
thread_summary: LumenResell billed duplicate marketplace fee; finance refunded $250 and issued $50 goodwill credit (CN-1860). Root cause: partner-sync duplicate run; ENG ticket created.
